w:r.w:t: The Parcelpost API lets your store buy shipping labels, book collections and follow parcels without leaving your own system. Every call is plain HTTPS with JSON bodies, and every call can be tried in the sandbox first.
Test keys create sandbox shipments that never reach a carrier. Switch to a live key only after the checklist on the last page.
Create an account and open the Developers page.
Copy your test key. It starts with pk_test_ and works only in the sandbox.
Send the request below with your key in the Authorization header.
Store the returned id and poll the tracking endpoint, or register a webhook.
All paths are relative to https://api.example.com. Send the key as a bearer token; limits are per key.
List shipments, newest first. Filter by status or date.
Create a shipment and buy its label.
Fetch one shipment with its current status.
Cancel a shipment that has not been collected.
Download the label as a PDF or PNG.
Book a courier collection for a date and time window.
Read the tracking events for a parcel.
Register an endpoint to receive shipment events.

The shipment or pickup does not exist.
Check the id; cancelled shipments stay readable.
Too many requests in the current minute.
Wait for the Retry-After header, then retry.
Parcelpost calls your endpoint when a shipment changes state. Each delivery is signed, so check the signature before you trust the body.
Switch from the test key to a live key
Store the key in server-side configuration, not in code
Verify the signature on every webhook

Send a test shipment and cancel it
Retries are on our side. Answer quickly and keep your handler boring.
